//: Claude Code: one entry per gitlab-mcp deployment. 'type':'http' is required. See docs/auth.md for how the OIDC client config depends on Dynamic Client Registration (DCR).

gitlab.//: OIDC without DCR (e.g. Authentik): give the pre-registered public client_id plus the provider's discovery URL. Browser login on first use; run: claude mcp login gitlab.

gitlab-dcr.//: OIDC with a DCR-capable provider (e.g. Keycloak): just the URL — the client self-registers.

gitlab-static.//: Static bearer token, for machine callers.
